fireCrystal.line: Fire Crystal and Refined Fire Crystal costs for each building. Reference only, nothing here is saved to your chief.
fireCrystal.description: Fire Crystals and Refined Fire Crystals each building needs to reach each Fire Crystal level. A level adds up the five upgrades that end at its base row. A dash means the building has no cost for that level.
fireCrystal.tableLabel: Fire Crystal cost for each building

shards.line: Fire Crystal Shard and Refined Fire Crystal costs of T11 and T12 troop research. Reference only, nothing here is saved to your chief.
shards.description: Fire Crystal Shards and Refined Fire Crystals for T11 and T12 troop research. The Unlock row adds up the research that unlocks the troop: tiers 1 to 5 for T11 and tier 1 for T12. The extras are the research after that. T11 costs no Refined Fire Crystals. A dash means the research has no cost in that column.
shards.tableLabel: Fire Crystal Shard cost for each troop research
